English: Inventor Claims Levitation Around the Corner
Soon you will see me levitating to the market in a fortnite's time. Other inventors Skepical.
After a recent survey, it appears the consensus is that the finest fabrics in the world at those made in Hetsteen.
In a small village some of the awful paupers spat on some soldiers. The local police have decided to cane them.
A very old man was found in $ANYPROVINCE$ who is certain the world is going to end soon. He said 'I saw it clear as day'.
Rowdy young folk seem to be playing some new game where they whack eachother violently. They call it 'the Norseman's Game'.
A leading author in $OURCOUNTRY$ has written a charming new novel. It features the story of a likely heir who has been defrauded of his inheritance.
A prominent aristocrat killed himself in a particularly tragic way. He leaped off a cliff after denouncing the world.
In the reaches of Lappland, one reporter was told by a very old man that there are dancing snakes deep in the hills, which were male genitals that had been cut off and given spirits by witches.
An expert says that war is caused by population density. He says: if people did not live so close, they would not want to shoot eachother.
It is strange: on election day, some good men vote for the bad, and some bad men vote for the good.
I think that politicians are wicked men and that they are taking their orders from Lappland witches! We should stop listing to them, the police, and the church!
We are surrounded by evil and greedy neighbours who covet our wealth and lands.
I hit a Man with a Stick!
Local gentlemen recalls supreme delight in giving some poor sap a satisfying whacking with blackthorn rod.
A man who was recently arrested for belligerence has claimed to be under the influence of witches he said be met abroad. The constabulary indeed found strange objects at his home.
A very wealthy heir to a large banking fortune has taken out a large loan. Economic pundits worried about state of loan market. "This could cause great problems" says professor.
We are always very truthful and get you the news the fastest!
A man recently slaughtered his brother in a particularly brutal fashion, and made an effigy out of his corpse. A sketch included on p. 4.
This reporter recently was lucky enough to view the coronation of the Prince of Bhotan. It was spledid affair, and the king had six white horses in tow.
This newspaper is an awful rag. Any fool would know the Prince of Bhotan did not have six horses at his coronation, as you say, but 8 giant eunuchs.
The police recently found a disoriented man lost in the woods. No one knows where he came from, and he doesn't even know where from either.
Policemen in $ANYPROVINCE$$ urge citizens to remain calm until they catch the murderer.
All sorts of horrendous and terrible things are happening beyond our shores. Goodness knows we do not want to abroad in this troubled world!
